Relations - Bands
Home » Statistical Information » Relations » Relations - Bands

Listed below are the bands that Springsteen has played and recorded with. Click the name for information about the date and locations. This includes:

  • the occasions that a band have joined Bruce on stage during an band or solo gig
  • the occasions that Bruce has joined a band on stage
  • the occasions that Bruce has contributed in a band's studio session
  • the occasions that other bands have contributed to a Springsteen album

When E Street / 1992-93 World Tour / Seeger Sessions members are listed, this assumes events outside of touring activities, including off-tour appearances such as Christmas shows, benefits, television performances etc. See the "Springsteen's Band'-section" in Statistics for information and performance lists for the bands. For those that prefer to scroll take a look at the dynamic full-list.

We currently have a total of 270 different bands listed.
